products.name: Bonding Primer
products.desc: A water-based acrylic primer that seals the substrate and provides adhesion for the coats above. The film has real elongation, moving with minor substrate movement and reducing the risk of delamination.
feat: Tensile strength 2.7 N/mm², elongation at break 60%

products.name: Texture Coat
products.desc: A high-build texture layer applied over the primer, forming approx. 1–2 mm of relief in a single pass. It is the base for the multi-colour coat and sets the depth and consistency of the stone texture.
feat: Adhesion 21.1 kgf/cm² standard, 14.6 kgf/cm² after immersion
Alkali, boiling-water and impact resistant; no cracking under thermal cycling
Single-pass application with a consistent texture

products.name: Coloured Topcoat
products.desc: A bright, weather-resistant coloured coat beneath the multi-colour layer. It improves overall opacity and colour depth so the substrate never shows between the stone particles.
feat: 100% opacity in white and light colours

products.name: Multi-Colour Granite Coat
products.desc: Produced using an advanced granulation process, a single product contains five or more distinct colour particles. Sprayed in one pass, the particles merge into a film reproducing the appearance of natural granite, with genuine relief, a coarse tactile finish and rich colour.
feat: Over 90% visual match to natural granite
Water and alkali resistant; withstands 300 scrub cycles

products.name: Clear Protective Coat
products.desc: A water-based acrylic resin synthesised with silane, forming a dense, transparent and tough film. Durable against weathering, water and staining, easy to wash down, and gives lasting protection to the stone-effect layers below.
feat: Available in gloss or matt to suit the design

steps.name: Substrate preparation
steps.desc: Clean the substrate; level cement residue and uneven areas; fill voids and cracks with resin mortar; abrade surfaces that are too smooth

steps.name: Bonding primer
steps.desc: Water-based acrylic primer applied evenly over the whole surface

steps.name: Joint masking (optional)
steps.desc: Set out joint positions and widths to the shop drawing; use tape that leaves no adhesive and remove it immediately after the stone-effect coat

steps.name: Texture coat
steps.desc: Sprayed in one pass to approx. 1–2 mm with a consistent texture; use the same gun and equipment throughout large areas

steps.name: Coloured topcoat
steps.desc: Mix thoroughly and spray evenly and continuously with a topcoat gun or pressure-pot gun

steps.name: Multi-colour granite coat
steps.desc: May be thinned with a little separating agent or water; restore consistency by gentle rocking or pouring between pails — never mix hard, which breaks the colour particles

steps.name: Clear protective coat
steps.desc: Spray once the main coat is fully dry, evenly over all surfaces
